'''Pol Orrich''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Centerpoint Station Security]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] but was bribed by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Benton Kaldo]], a businessman and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Centerpoint Station]].
